product_metadata.title: Bar Soap Holder Leaf Shape - Self Draining Soap Dish for Bar Soap, Decorative Plastic Soap Tray, Soap Box with Suction Cup for Shower Bathroom Kitchen Sink(Not Punched)
features: 🍃【Leaf Shaped Soap Holder】: Our bar soap holder is different from the ordinary soap holder, we adopt the leaf shape design, which makes water flows down naturally and keeps the soap dry all the time. And it also as a cute decoration adds art to your life.

🍃【Self Draining Soap Dish】: The hollow gaps can let water drain down to the bottom and the raised triangle in the middle prevents soap from sliding off. This bar soap dish avoids the soap becoming soggy and mushy and also keeps the sink tidy.

🍃【Easy To Install】: This soap box holder has three silicone suction cups on the bottom, it can be firmly fixed on the table. The plastic soap box is easy to install, you don't need punch holes, and it has strong adhesion to keep the soap bar holder stable.

🍃【Multi-Purpose Soap Dish Holder】: The soap dish with drain can hold bar soap, sponges, dish brushes, razors and more. It's also easy to clean and perfect for bathroom, kitchen, shower, laundry room, or mudroom. It will look great in any home!

🍃【100% Satisfactory Service】: We attach great importance to your usage experience. If you are not satisfied with our leaf soap holder, please contact us, we are honored to provide you with services. Your satisfaction is our unremitting pursuit!

details.Specific instructions for use: Wipe the suction cups and the surface to make it be smoother. Dip the suction cups with water and press to remove air.
